title: THE WORLD'S
10 MOST VISITED
COUNTRIES

hook.say: The ten most visited countries on Earth, ranked. Six of them are in Europe!

outro.say: Which one is on your list? Comment below!

outroLines: WHICH ONE IS ON YOUR LIST?

items.name: Greece
items.say: Number ten: Greece, land of thousands of islands. 36 million visitors a year.
items.cap: Number ten: Greece, land of thousands of islands. 36 million visitors a year.

items.name: Japan
items.say: Nine: Japan, in a record year. Almost 37 million visitors.
items.cap: Nine: Japan, in a record year. Almost 37 million visitors.

items.name: Germany
items.say: Eight: Germany, the heart of Europe. Thirty-seven-point-five million visitors.
items.cap: Eight: Germany, the heart of Europe. 37.5 million visitors.

items.name: United Kingdom
items.say: Seven: the United Kingdom, led by London. Almost 42 million visitors.
items.cap: Seven: the United Kingdom, led by London. Almost 42 million visitors.

items.name: Mexico
items.say: Six: Mexico, the top spot in Latin America. 45 million visitors.
items.cap: Six: Mexico, the top spot in Latin America. 45 million visitors.

items.name: Italy
items.say: Five: Italy, home of Rome and Venice. Almost 58 million visitors.
items.cap: Five: Italy, home of Rome and Venice. Almost 58 million visitors.

items.name: Türkiye
items.say: Four: Turkey, where Europe meets Asia. Over 60 million visitors.
items.cap: Four: Türkiye, where Europe meets Asia. Over 60 million visitors.

items.name: United States
items.say: Three: the United States. 72 million visitors, and the most tourism money.
items.cap: Three: the United States. 72 million visitors, and the most tourism money.

items.name: Spain
items.say: Two: Spain, land of sun and beaches. Almost 94 million visitors.
items.cap: Two: Spain, land of sun and beaches. Almost 94 million visitors.

items.name: France
items.say: And number one: France! About 100 million visitors, more than the people living there.
